title: Decontamination Kit
sideASummary: Player deck back. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Unrationed Event, Decontamination Kit. Remove all Plague cubes from 1 location on the grid. Destroy this card after use. Play at any time. Not an action. Code P1-02b.

rules: Play at any time. It is not an action.
Remove all Plague cubes from 1 location on the grid.
Destroy this card after use. It does not return to the deck or the reserve.
notes: Card id 901. Printed code P1-02b. Side A has no code.
P1-01b gives this card to a player when the package is opened voluntarily.
The screen title reads DECONTAMINATION KIT under the UNRATIONED EVENT banner.
